The in-focus surfaces two refinements learned, in camera coordinates (the camera centre is the black dot, $z$ runs along the optical axis; one scale on the three axes): every pixel's in-focus point on its ray. The lines follow the pixel lattice, every 224\,px (fisheye lens) and every 448\,px (Tamron 20\,mm lens); a cell's colour is its mean focus distance, from the panel's nearest cell (light) to its farthest (dark), as the key under the panel states. Over all pixels the focus distance is 0.51 to 0.78\,m (fisheye lens, $f/4$) and 0.21 to 0.33\,m (Tamron 20\,mm lens, $f/8$).
